deployments_detail.use: AI competency assessment in new-hire recruitment (2025); no confirmed manufacturing/product AI deployment found

AI competency assessment (AI 역량검사, incl. AI interview) used as a standard, recurring step in KT&G's blind new-graduate and experienced-hire recruitment process to evaluate cognitive ability, problem-solving and disposition. [none]

Internal generative-AI in-house instructor training program (생성형 AI를 활용한 사내강사 양성과정) — KT&G HRD program training employees to build training content and personal course pages using generative AI tools; multiple cohorts run in 2025-2026. [none]

lil AIBLE heat-not-burn device with embedded 'Smart AI' — Preheating AI (calculates ambient temperature/humidity + stick manufacturing variance to optimize heating), Puff AI (proposes puff count/usage time), and Charging AI (optimal charge timing). First HNB product in the industry to embed AI. [KT&G (in-house)]

lil Solid 3.0 device 'SMART ON' feature — sensor/AI-driven auto-heating that detects the tobacco stick as it is inserted and instantly begins heating, plus fast charging and boost mode. [KT&G (in-house)]

Daejeon cigarette plant smart-factory program — plan to graft AI systems onto the highly automated line (29 lines, 14,000 cigarettes/minute) to extend from manufacturing into AI-based diagnostics; described as an in-progress build (currently sensor-based), so AI diagnostics not yet in production. [KT&G (in-house)]

RAISON D'ETRE A.I COLLABOR limited-edition cigarette line whose pack graphics were created using generative AI graphic technology (2000s-inspired 'newtro' concept), released in Blue and Black variants. [KT&G (in-house)]

New unified commerce platform built on Salesforce Agentforce / Commerce Cloud, connecting commerce, CRM and an integrated database into a 'Golden Customer 360' single-ID platform; composable/headless architecture with real-time multi-warehouse inventory and automated fulfillment. KT&G chose a proven external AI platform rather than building AI in-house; plans to extend with device recommendations and autonomous customer-service agents. [Salesforce (Agentforce Commerce / Commerce Cloud)]

KT&G Sangsangmadang 20th-anniversary 'AI-based Art Support Project' — an open call and exhibition supporting artists creating experimental work through human-AI collaboration (accepting applications Mar-Apr 2025; exhibition later in 2025). [KT&G Sangsangmadang]
